summary: Aermotor fire tower in Blue Rock State Forest, Muskingum County, OH; NHLR gives 1937 build, a 1938 item suggests construction ran into 1938; NHLR-registered 2007.

facts.design: Aermotor tower with a 7 by 7 foot metal cab

events.note: NHLR gives 1937 as the build year; a May 1938 newspaper item describes footings poured and the tower still being constructed
May 1938 Zanesville Signal item: footings poured for the 100-foot tower under construction; ranger house nearing completion
Arthur M. Winland took his first job at Blue Rock State Forest in 1939 as a fire tower guard
In September 1966 a state forestry plane skidded off a runway near the tower; the pilot had a minor injury

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 1937. A May 1938 newspaper item, reprinted on Forest Lookouts, describes footings poured and the tower still under construction, which points to 1938 for at least part of the work. The story reports both and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Access and current condition are not confirmed. The ODNR pages for this tower returned 404 when fetched, so their claims about climbing and CCC construction are not quoted or relied on; verify them before publishing. Height 30.5 m is taken from the 100-foot figure in the 1938 item. No named fires found. Record rests on NHLR plus two secondary lists.
